source_note: 由一个级数收敛证明另一个有关级数的收敛问题
english_source_note: Deducing One Series Convergence from Another
callout_id: 由一个级数收敛证明另一个有关级数的收敛问题#9
statement_en: Let $f:[0,+\infty)\to [0,+\infty)$ be nondecreasing, and suppose $\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{f(x)}{x}=1$. Then for any nonnegative real sequence $a_n$, the series $\sum_n a_n$ and $\sum_n f(a_n)$ converge or diverge simultaneously.
callout_body: 若$f:[0,+\infty)\to [0,+\infty)$单调不减，且$\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{f(x)}{x}=1$则对于任意非负实数列$a_n$,级数$\sum_n a_n$与$\sum_n f(a_n)$同时收敛与发散。
